subject: Insurance
title: The Claims Process
description: A quick win: understand The Claims Process.

hook.text: When someone dies, the beneficiary files a claim with a death certificate. Most claims are paid within 30-60 days.

buildup.text: The insurer verifies the policy is active, the death is covered, and the claimant is the named beneficiary.

discovery.text: About 99.8% of claims are paid. Denials are rare and usually involve fraud, material misrepresentation, or policy lapse.

twist.text: Unclaimed life insurance is a $7.4 billion problem.

climax.text: The claims process is straightforward, but the biggest risk isn't denial—it's that nobody knows the policy exists.

quiz.question: What is the biggest issue with life insurance claims?
options: Billions go unclaimed because families don't know policies exist
